question: ‘How to safeguard the health and rights of women and girls now’ was the theme of World Population Day ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__2020__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• World Population Day is celebrated on July 11, every year, in order to spread and raise awareness of the rising global population issues.
 
• The day was invented by the Governing Council of the United Nations Development Programme, way back in 1989.
 
• The theme for the year 2020 is How to safeguard the health and rights of women and girls now amid the pandemic.
